pluginConfigFields.label: Windows acquisition backend
pluginConfigFields.help: Native USB uses the existing Tektronix RSA USB driver without RSA_API.dll. The fallback requires the installed Tektronix x64 API. Stop and close live scans before changing this setting.

pluginConfigFields.label: Tektronix API path (Windows fallback)
pluginConfigFields.help: Used only by the Tektronix API fallback. Optional absolute path to RSA_API.dll, or its directory. Leave empty for standard installation locations.

pluginConfigFields.label: Native worker path (advanced)
pluginConfigFields.help: Optional absolute path to a compatible rsa306 worker for macOS arm64 or rsa306.exe for Windows x64. Leave empty to use the bundled worker.

pluginConfigFields.label: Python interpreter (advanced, Windows fallback)
pluginConfigFields.help: Used only by the Tektronix API fallback. Optional absolute path to Python. Leave empty to use the bundled isolated runtime.

deviceConfigFields.label: Analyzer serial number
deviceConfigFields.help: Select the attached analyzer by serial number. Discovery fills this automatically.
